name: GlassJelly
overview: Liquid Glass theme for the Jellyfin web client.
description: Apple-style Liquid Glass for jellyfin-web: clear glass capsules and panels that bend what is behind them, an ambient background from the artwork, glass buttons, menus, dialogs, player and dashboard. No Custom CSS needed; a settings page turns the logo, ambient background, hover light and player tweaks on or off.

versions.changelog:
- Header on servers without Jellyfin Enhanced (or with File Transformation broken, which stops Jellyfin Enhanced from
  loading): the icon capsule (SyncPlay, Cast, Search) spanned the whole header on desktop, lay over the nav capsule and
  its lens bent the tab labels into ghost copies above and below them. It now hugs its icons on every width, as it
  already did on phones. Checked with and without Jellyfin Enhanced on home, library, details and the dashboard at
  1920, 1280 and 390 px.

- Player header (Jellyfin 12 draws it with React, `.videoOsd-appBar`): Back, SyncPlay and Cast are glass beads like the
  rest of the header; they were bare glyphs, because the theme only styled the legacy `.headerButton`.
- Jellyfin Enhanced pause screen: the close button is a glass bead with a drawn X, centred (the "×" character sat ~2px
  low), and on phones the Back bead is no longer cut in half (the plugin narrows the header to 10vw, 39px).
- QA: a full pass with the real player (local test clip, playback reports blocked so no resume position is written)
  over home, details, season, episode, libraries, sort menu, search, user menu, drawer, settings, dashboard, the
  GlassJelly page, the player with its subtitle and settings menus and the pause screen, on desktop and phone.

- Phones: the icons in the episode-row buttons are centred. 2.9.3 made the buttons 36px circles but kept their 8px
  padding, which left 20px for a 24px icon and pushed it 2px down-right; the button now centres a 20px icon. A scan of
  every round button on home, movie, series, season and settings pages (Android, iPhone, desktop) checks both the
  shape and the icon centre.

- Phones: the round buttons of the episode rows (info, played, favourite, more) were 36×44 ovals: the 44px touch
  minimum height won over their 36px size. They are circles again. A scan of home, movie, series, season and settings
  pages (Android, iPhone, desktop) finds no other oval round button.

- Header lens on touch screens: Chromium browsers (Chrome / Brave / Edge / Samsung Internet on Android, and the
  DevTools device mode on a PC) now get the desktop's refracting header capsules; until now the lens needed a mouse,
  so they fell back to frosted glass. The plugin marks them with `html.gj-lens`. iPhone / iPad (every browser is
  WebKit, no lens) keep the clear glass with a light blur from 2.9.1.
- Media Bar: the mute button is always shown. The plugin hides it on slides without a trailer; there it now stays in
  place and sets the sound for the next trailer.

- Phones: the header capsules (menu, actions, avatar) use the desktop's clear glass (the same fill, rim and label
  shadow) with a light 3px blur, instead of the heavy frost (blur 10px + saturate 180%) that turned the page behind
  them into a tinted cloud. The scroll edge behind them is the desktop's again. Phones still have no lens: Safari
  can't do it and 21l stays Chromium desktop only.

- Plugin: new **Colours** settings. **Background**: Graphite (default), Midnight blue, Ocean, Forest, Plum, Wine,
  Espresso, OLED black or a custom colour; it tints the canvas, the dark glass of menus, dialogs and the player, and
  lays a veil of the colour over the ambient artwork, while staying dark (a custom colour gives its hue, not its
  brightness). **Accent**: White (default), Blue, Indigo, Purple, Pink, Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Teal or custom;
  fills progress bars, slider tracks, checkboxes and the Save / Sign In buttons (Play / Resume stay clear glass).
  **Ambient strength**: Subtle, Normal, Vivid. The defaults render exactly as before.
- Phones: the header is the floating glass capsules of the desktop instead of a solid near-black bar, over a deeper
  scroll-edge fade.
- Stylesheet: the dark tints of the glass are `--gj-ink*` tokens and the accent drives progress bars (section 1, 21u),
  so a CSS-only install can recolour them too.

- Fix: the Media Bar mute toggle showed its icon pushed into the top-left corner, half outside the glass bead. The
  plugin shows and hides the button with an inline `display`, which overrode the theme's centring; the icon is now
  centred independently of `display`.

- One material: every glass control and surface uses the header capsule's glass (section 21t). Play / Resume (details
  page and Media Bar) are clear header glass with a white label instead of milky white; the round buttons next to them,
  poster and episode beads, toolbar, pickers, link pills and login buttons share the header's fill, gentle lens and
  rim. Menus, action sheets, dialogs, panels, the player OSD, the now-playing bar, toasts and dashboard cards keep a
  darker tint for long text but use the same rim (one ring + top-left bevel, no doubled arcs at rounded ends).
- Selected and hover states match the header's selected tab and hover everywhere (menu items, sidebars, segmented
  controls, Media Bar settings tab, plugin tabs, picker options).
- Fixes: player OSD buttons no longer carry a lens inside the panel; filter popover sections are no longer grey slabs;
  the poster play bead has no blur at rest on every card; the login buttons' lens and the full-width Cancel now apply.

- Plugin: new option **Subtitle lift** (off by default). While the player controls are visible, subtitles rise just
  above them (the bar height is measured live, so it is right at any resolution) and settle back when they hide; the
  Subtitle Appearance dialog applies to every subtitle type, ASS/SSA included. It sets every user's subtitle styling to
  "Custom", hence opt-in. Per device: `localStorage.jfSubGap` (px above the bar, default 20) and
  `localStorage.jfSubRest` (px at rest, default -1). Script: `src/js/sublift.js`.

- GlassJelly is installable from Jellyfin's plugin catalog: add
  `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FlorinCamarut1/glassjelly/main/manifest.json` in Dashboard → Plugins → Manage
  Repositories, then install GlassJelly. Every release tag builds the plugin on GitHub Actions and adds it to the
  manifest, so updates show up in the dashboard.
- The plugin has its own image in the catalog and the plugin list.
